limits: This closes a bounded mechanism slice, not V1-05 or the complete V1 plan.
A repeat preserves configuration, seed, semantic execution and specification fingerprints; it does not prove statistical independence, measurement validity, or research benefit.

The first coordinator adapter requires a current confirmed native B1 train-kind source; old imported completed flags cannot acquire authority. Generic request storage permits other source phases but does not implement a CPU adapter.
An exact control replay verifies the current source/inputs and returns the same task without reset; changed source, project or reason rejects, not silent new work.
Explicitly confirmed failed/not_started/requeued native task retries remain eligible only with an actual new authorized claim. Interrupted checkpoint resume for replica tasks is not yet supported.
Additional third-party/user-installed policy and dedup hooks may veto a task and are not silently bypassed; this validation covers the built-in path, not every optional external extension.
Proposal append counts are not durable task admissions or completed replications. Existing descriptive labels remain data and cannot grant slots.
Filesystem occurrence slots and SQLite are not atomic; unresolved writes/owners remain HOLD, with no age-based takeover or automatic external-effect recovery claim.
Cooperative stat/digest/claim checks are not a hostile same-UID filesystem/SQL sandbox or a freeze of every interpreter package, import, inherited environment variable or dataset.
No real training, paid provider, production licensing change, GPU workload, holdout read, release, deployment, main merge, CPU autoresearch loop or general efficiency gain is claimed.
